raw.title: Mondstadt
raw.description: A city of freedom that lies in the northeast of Teyvat. From amongst mountains and wide-open plains, carefree breezes carry the scent of dandelions — a gift from the Anemo God, Barbatos — across Cider Lake to Mondstadt, which sits on an island in the middle of the lake.

raw.title: Liyue
raw.description: A bountiful harbor that lies in the east of Teyvat. Mountains stand tall and proud alongside the stone forest, that, together with the open plains and lively rivers, make up Liyue's bountiful landscape, which shows its unique beauty through each of the four seasons. Just how many gifts from the Geo God lie in wait amongst the rocks of Liyue's mountains?

raw.title: Snezhnaya
raw.description: She is a god with no love left for her people, nor do they have any left for her. Her followers only hope to be on her side when the day of her rebellion against the divine comes at last.

raw.title: Khaenri'ah
raw.description: Khaenri'ah was a nation without a god — not because it had a god that died or abandoned them, but because it never had a god to begin with. It was a powerful nation, built purely by humans, an unprecedented flourishing and glorious civilization — it was the pride of humankind.

raw.title: Sumeru
raw.description: The city of scholars located in the west-central part of Teyvat. A fantastical nation of both lush rainforest and barren desert, where countless fruits of wisdom grow and are buried. Whether Travelers travel from afar through the forest to reach the academy city or delve deep into the desert to discover the historical ruins of the red desert, a wealth of valuable knowledge awaits them here.

raw.title: Inazuma
raw.description: An Isolated Archipelago Far East of Teyvat Overcome endless thunderstorms and set foot on the islands of red maple and cherry blossoms. On winding shores and towering cliffs, and in forests and mountains full of secrets, witness the Eternity pursued by Her Excellency, the Almighty Narukami Ogosho.

raw.title: Fontaine
raw.description: A terrestrial sea in the center of Teyvat. Following the direction of pure currents, crossing wilderness, the depths of the forests and vastness of the sea of sand, arriving at the origin of all the waters of the continent. At the top of the waterfall, in the depths of the capital atop the terrestrial sea... a story that has never been heard, a legend that has been forgotten, like a lost kingdom sunken beneath the waves, yearning for a bard to sing its drowned songs.

raw.title: Natlan
raw.description: The nation of oaths situated in the western regions of Teyvat. Guided by the flame, you pass through lengthy gorges and valleys to reach the land where the torches blaze, where all fires converge. Upon the blazing fields where Saurians roam, witness the end of the ancient war alongside the valiant warriors who resist the darkness.

raw.title: Nod-Krai
raw.description: The moon-blessed land located in the northwestern regions of Teyvat. Follow the silver thread spun by the new moon, traverse biting gales and desolate tundras as the snow-kissed lakes, fractured like mirrors, reflect their ageless, glacial radiance. The days are bitterly short, and the night stretches on like a dark, yawning maw. But even then, the light and song of the Welkin Moon will dance gently across the faces of visiting travelers. Up at ye towers, and let your lanterns blaze into the darkness! Until the day comes… when true moonlight bathes this land once more.

raw.title: The Chasm (Subregion)
raw.description: In the recent past, a series of mysterious accidents led the entire mine to be closed, putting its workers out of a job. However, the Liyue Qixing is gradually reopening the area, thus allowing miners to resume working. Beneath the Seven-Star Array is the Underground Mines.

raw.title: Chenyu Vale
raw.description: The gentle breezes carry the fragrance of tea all across the mountains of Liyue, filling the air with the savory scent once more. "Tea grows upon the rocks, where jade springs endlessly flow." The faint perfume and ancient song of jade drift together along the rivers past Qiaoying Village to the bustling port of Yilong Wharf. Just what adventures and fortune await, concealed among the fog-robed peaks of the south...?

raw.title: Dharma Forest
raw.description: It is the rainforest subregion for this nation.

raw.title: Great Red Sand
raw.description: It is one of the two desert subregions for this nation.

raw.title: Girdle of the Sands
raw.description: Legend has it that in the depths of the boundless desert lies a forbidden realm where few have ever set foot. Beneath the barren wasteland, along with the ruins of an ancient civilization and the legacy of the divine, only a hidden lost Darshan and mythical creatures safeguard the long-sealed memories...

raw.title: Frost Moon
raw.description: It is accessed by progressing the .

raw.title: Lisha
raw.description: Beyond the Chasm

raw.title: Bishui Plain
raw.description: The Bishui River passes through it.

raw.title: Dragonspine
raw.description: It is a vast mountain, engulfed with ancient ruins and snow-capped areas, and also containing the remains of Durin. It was named Vindagnyr prior to Durin's fall. There are some peculiarities with how the snow gathers but never melts on the mountain. Due to its extreme cold, Dragonspine is also one of the most dangerous places in Mondstadt.

raw.title: Narukami Island
raw.description: The area spans across Ritou, its port of entry, to Mt. Yougou which is home to the Grand Narukami Shrine, and on its coast is Inazuma City. It also has a mass of dense forests under the moonlight and underwater ruins alike. It is where the Inazuma Shogunate primarily takes rule, enforcing policies and laws in accordance to the Sakoku Decree. Inazuman public festivals and cultural events are being held here.

raw.title: Kannazuka
raw.description: Behind the rocky outcrops lies Mikage Furnace, the largest smelting facility in Inazuma and is also home to the battlefront fortress of the Shogunate's forces. It is considered to be disputed territory between the Inazuma Shogunate and the Watatsumi Army. The area neither belongs to both armies and neither Inazuman faith nor Sangonomiya faith has any influence. For this reason, this area is called Kannazuka, which means "the hill where no gods reside."

raw.title: Enkanomiya
raw.description: It can be entered via a deep pool east of Sangonomiya Shrine. According to legend, the Watatsumi people originated from here. Enkanomiya is located under Watatsumi Island, and can be considered either part of Teyvat, even though it is somewhat disconnected from it, or fully separate and part of the Dark Sea, instead. To enter Enkanomiya, the seals on the five Goshou Rocks need to be broken. The pearls located within the five shrines are needed for the Key of the Moon-Bathed Deep, which would allow entry to Enkanomiya, provided that the spirit veins connecting Enkanomiya and Watatsumi Island are flowing smoothly and a person whose heart is "as clear as water." According to legend, the key was forged from Orobashi's blood.

raw.title: Avidya Forest
raw.description: Avidya Forest is a lush, green forest located in eastern Sumeru. It is the main area and most populous section of Sumeru apart from Ardravi Valley. The forest is also home to Sumeru City which houses The Akademiya, and Gandharva Ville, which is the base of the Forest Watchers. The Forest Watchers have guarded the forest for many years in order to ensure the forest's survival. Many unique flora and fauna grow in the Avidya Forest, such as Padisarahs, Nilopata Lotuses or Rukkhashava Mushrooms. Apart from Flowers, there are also different species and breeds of animals found, like Shroomboars. In the forest, you wil also find many, many special breeds of Shroomkin out in the wild.

raw.title: Lokapala Jungle
raw.description: The area spans near the north coast of Dharma Forest. It begins at Mawtiyima Forest, which is close to Minlin and Chenyu Vale: Southern Mountain, ends at the west slope of a nameless mountain to the west of Bayda Harbor, connecting with Desert of Hadramaveth and Realm of Farakhkert.

raw.title: Lost Nursery
raw.description: It is unlocked by completing the Aranyaka: Part III - Nursery of Lost Dreams quest, For Fruits, Seeds, and Trees.

raw.title: Land of Lower Setekh
raw.description: The Barren Land Where Sand Dances

raw.title: Land of Upper Setekh
raw.description: It is named as such because this land is in the direction of the sun at noon.

raw.title: Beryl Region
raw.description: An ancient ruin-studded mountain range across the water from the Court of Fontaine. Many, many centuries ago, the followers of Egeria once saw this place as a prime location for excursions and picnics. Gathered here, they sang of love and dreams as pure and stainless as polished gems. Their songs have long faded into the pale moonlight, and now, only cool breezes continue to caress these lonely, mint-studded highlands.

raw: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region

raw.pageTitle: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region
raw.title: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region
raw.description: It is the area where the eponymous Fontaine Research Institute is located. Years before, most of the institute was destroyed in an explosion caused by Edwin Eastinghouse's research into Arkhium, leaving behind structures such as Allogravity-Condensed Water Bodies floating in the air. The institute is also the site of the Experimental Field Generator boss. YouTube: [https://youtu.be/NUBIYZ_KQFc Version 4.1 Special Program]
raw.image: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region.png

raw.title: Mt. Laixin
raw.description: It is unlocked during the . It is referred to as "the sacred mountain," and is where the spirit veins of Chenyu Vale converge. Thus, controlling Mt. Laixin allows one to control all land in Chenyu Vale.

raw.title: Nostoi Region
raw.description: It is not located on the raised continental plate that the rest of Fontaine is situated on, so waters around it cannot be dived into.

raw.title: Coatepec Mountain
raw.description: A towering peak that also serves as the dwelling of the Scions of the Canopy. Legend has it that the warriors of the Scions of the Canopy, along with one hundred Yumkasaurs, spent a hundred days and a hundred ropes moving the “Obsidian Totem Pole,” the symbol of their faith, to its current location.

raw.title: Basin of Unnumbered Flames
raw.description: Where the Stadium of the Sacred Flame is situated. Members of the Saurian Relics Association once surveyed the terrain and concluded that this basin was not a natural formation, but rather the result of a colossal object crashing down here many years ago. However, what exactly that colossal object was remains a mystery for which no one has been able to provide a definite answer. Perhaps if the ancient Sacred Flames could speak, they might just hear the answer they seek. Alas, the flames on the Stele of the Sacred Flame burn on, and have yet to answer anyone’s questions.

raw.title: Atocpan
raw.description: It contains the Great Volcano of Tollan along with the home of the Collective of Plenty.

raw.title: Ancient Sacred Mountain
raw.description: It is located within the Great Volcano of Tollan and contains the Sacred City of Tollan, the capital of the ancient dragon civilization that once dominated Natlan. The player gains access to it via the .

raw.title: Hiisi Island
raw.description: It is also a part of the Southern Isles It is the home of the Frostmoon Scions, a religious sect devoted to the Goddess of the New Moon. Under their stewardship, much of the island remains an untouched wilderness.

raw.title: Easybreeze Holiday Resort
raw.description: It is a stunning, sparsely inhabited island off the westernmost edge of Natlan where the war had begun and met its end.

raw.title: Paha Isle
raw.description: It is a part of the Southern Isles and a staging ground for Fatui personnel based in Nod-Krai, operating through a high-tech complex called the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau.

raw.title: Lempo Isle
raw.description: It is also a part of the Southern Isles. The Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop run by Aino is based here. YouTube: [https://youtu.be/a6FB9NU_Vr8 Character Teaser - "Ineffa: Gift From the Artificed"]

raw.title: Ashveil Peak
raw.description: It is also a part of Pohjola.

raw.title: Moontide Sea
raw.description: Sea of Broken Skies

raw.title: Dark Side of the Moon
raw.description: The Dark Fortress

raw.title: Starfell Valley
raw.description: It is considered the most diverse region of Mondstadt, spreading far from the tip of Stormbearer Point to the ends of the Whispering Woods. It is also home to the City of Mondstadt in Cider Lake. The area also consists of abundant lakes and tree variety. The area is where the Knights of Favonius's duties primarily takes place, protecting locals and travelers alike with guards patrolling around the area.

raw.title: Windwail Highland
raw.description: It is home to the idyllic town of Springvale and the chief winery of Mondstadt, Dawn Winery. It also spans far across the wolf-ruled Wolvendom. It is one of the more rustic areas around Mondstadt having clear springs, orchards and lush forests; until one reaches to Wolvendom, which is engulfed in higher enemy activity and is usually avoided by locals.

raw.title: Yashiori Island
raw.description: At some point within the last two thousand years, the island was attacked by the Watatsumi Omikami Orobashi no Mikoto, an ancient god who created Watatsumi Island. As a result of the heavy concentration of Tatarigami energy, the island suffers from torrential rainfall and frequent thunderstorms in the open, which in turn applies constant Wet status. Getting hit by a thunderstorm while raining can cause Electro-Charged. Until the quest Orobashi's Legacy is fully completed, this abnormal weather will remain on the island.

raw.title: Tsurumi Island
raw.description: Shrouded in a dense Fog, Tsurumi Island was home to two ancient civilizations. One buried deep underground, before the time of the Thunderbird's reign, known as the Pre-Thunderbird Civilization. The other coming some time after, the civilization where a tribe worshipped Kanna Kapatcir (becoming known as the Thunderbird Civilization) and were subsequently wiped out by it. The land has since somewhat regrown and is now inhabited by hilichurls, riftwolves and automatons.

raw.title: Watatsumi Island
raw.description: Among these islands, it is located the farthest and on the opposite end of Narukami Island. It is known for its dense foliage in breathtaking colors which are distinct from plants found elsewhere.

raw.title: Seirai Island
raw.description: It is said that the island once experienced a calamity and the center of the island was enveloped by a perpetual thunderstorm. This storm has resulted in the unique geography of the island. Until the Seirai Stormchasers quest series is completed, the center of the island is constantly afflicted with Balethunder and lightning that targets the player. Even after completing the quest series, Electrified Water will still persist at the center of the island, although it can be cleared by a nearby puzzle, which will reveal a large hole in the middle.

raw.title: The Chasm: Underground Mines
raw.description: It has its own map tab and exploration progress separated from the main map Teyvat.

raw.title: Veluriyam Mirage
raw.description: A Domain hidden within a wondrous bottle. It is a beautiful and quiet place, and various special Hydro life-forms dwell within it...

raw.title: The Chasm (Area)
raw.description: In the recent past, a series of mysterious accidents led the entire mine to be closed, putting its workers out of a job. However, the Liyue Qixing is gradually reopening the area, thus allowing miners to resume working. Beneath the Seven-Star Array is the Underground Mines.

raw.title: Vanarana (Area)
raw.description: Vanarana is the homeland and playground of the mysterious playful creatures known as Aranara.

raw.title: Sea of Bygone Eras
raw.description: It has its own map tab and exploration progress separate from the main map of Teyvat. It is unlocked after completing the .

raw.title: Tequemecan Valley
raw.description: The settlement of the tribe who live alongside the Tepetlisaurs, known as the "Children of Echoes." Whether it's the clanging of artisans' hammers or the tapping of gem hunters testing the rocks, echoing sounds can be heard throughout the canyon.

raw.title: Toyac Springs
raw.description: The tribe who lives alongside the Koholasaurs, known as the "People of the Springs," renowned for their hot springs and relaxing music. Among all the tribes, this is the most popular among visitors from afar.

raw.title: Tezcatepetonco Range
raw.description: It houses Masters of the Night-Wind.

raw.title: Wavechaser Plain
raw.description: It is also a part of Pohjola. The Pillar of Embla, Favonius Keep, and Lake Amsvartnir are based here.

raw.title: Voidsea Outlook
raw.description: It is located at the southern end of the island Pohjola, to the north of Paha Isle.

raw.title: Temple of Space
raw.description: The site was designated "Segment-Domain Tau" by its former owner, who possessed neither aesthetic sense nor sentiment. Long ago, it stood upon the surface as a temple devoted to a goddess often invoked alongside "Time." In the wake of a disaster, it was lifted into the heavens, its presence and shadow hidden from sight. From then on, it served as a quiet watchtower over the world. The ruins left behind were eventually expanded and transformed into a sanatorium.

raw.title: Windrest Peak
raw.description: As the northernmost part of Mondstadt, this area revolves around the port town of Dornman Port and other landmarks, such as Millhaven and the Old Sanatorium Site.

raw.title: Brightcrown Canyon
raw.description: The northeastern part of the canyon contains the eastern entrance to Stormterror's Lair, which was formerly the capital city of Decarabian's Mondstadt.

raw.title: Cape Oath
raw.description: In the southeast corner of Mondstadt's surrounds lies a cape that borders with Galesong Hill. Legend has it two lovers made an oath to each other here and left behind a deeply touching story. To this day the area is still known to be popular amongst young lovebirds. Other than being a great vantage point for watching sunrises and sunsets, the drop in terrain makes it easy to see Windrise, which sits facing the sea.

raw.title: Amakane Island
raw.description: It is a small festival island located off the western coast of Byakko Plain.

raw.title: Araumi
raw.description: It is a promontory at the northern point of Narukami Island, seemingly isolated from the rest of it by Mt. Yougou to the immediate south. The area is filled with the ruins of the ancient city, which extend deep beneath the earth and the surrounding waters, and which was abandoned after the Cataclysm.

raw.title: Byakko Plain
raw.description: It is a low, sparsely wooded field in the southwest of Narukami Island. The main road from Konda Village to Inazuma City runs through its center. Several Kitsune can be found roaming near the outskirts of the city.

raw.title: Amakumo Peak
raw.description: Long ago, Kanna Kapatcir was slain here, while the power of its lingering hatred and regret was suppressed by wards maintained by the Asase Shrine. During the Seirai Rebellion around 500 years ago, Asase Hibiki unsealed the wards, causing the Thunder Manifestation to appear and devastate the area with a massive Electro storm.

raw.title: Bourou Village
raw.description: It served as the camp where soldiers were trained during the Watatsumi Army's fight against the Shogunate.

raw.title: "Seiraimaru"
raw.description: The area takes its name after the Seiraimaru, the flagship of Ako Domeki's fleet which was destroyed here.

raw.title: Asase Shrine
raw.description: Where the Provisional Head Priestess Lives

raw.title: Autake Plains
raw.description: Most of Autake Plains was covered by an unremovable Fog, even after the completion of A Particularly Particular Author; if the Player stays inside the fog for too long without a Stormstone nearby, they will be teleported to the nearest Teleport Waypoint outside of the fog. After the completion of The Sun-Wheel and Mt. Kanna, the fog will permanently disappear, allowing easier exploration.

raw.title: Ad-Hoc Main Tunnel
raw.description: Serving as the main entrance to the Chasm's Mines, it consists of two huge caves with a smaller one in between.

raw.title: Aaru Village
raw.description: The largest human settlement in the desert, Aaru Village houses the followers and descendants of King Deshret, as well as exiled scholars from the Akademiya.

raw.title: Chatrakam Cave
raw.description: Chatrakam Cave is best known for containing a large number of Fungi, and humans typically do not go inside.

raw.title: Apam Woods
raw.description: It is a massive rainforest with trees that stretch towards the sky. After completing the World Quest A Prayer for Rain on the Fecund Land, the player will be able to operate the Varuna Contraption and control the rain.

raw.title: Caravan Ribat
raw.description: A fortified village at the foot of a tall wall that blocks the sandstorms from destroying the Sumeru rainforests. Located at the foot of the Wall of Samiel, Caravan Ribat serves as a thoroughfare for those coming from the forest going to Aaru Village, and vice versa.

raw.title: Abdju Pit
raw.description: Prior to Lost in the Sands, the pit is absent and it is named Abdju Road.

raw.title: Asipattravana Swamp
raw.description: Asipattravana Swamp is located in a thorn-filled canyon just north of Vourukasha Oasis. It is guarded by the Pari Mihir, a "familiar of thorns."

raw.title: Bayda Harbor
raw.description: It is located directly across from Fontaine.

raw.title: "A Very Warm Place"
raw.description: It is the location of Elynas' heart, hence the warm temperature. When the Traveler first encounters it, the heart is in a dormant state, covered in a layer of crystallized stone.

raw.title: "A Very Bright Place"
raw.description: It is a half-submerged cavern located within Elynas. It contains numerous ore veins and is filled with a congealed orange substance. It is unlocked after completing Step 3 in the .

raw.title: Annapausis
raw.description: It is unlocked during the , and is not labeled on the map prior to this.

raw.title: Central Laboratory Ruins
raw.parentTitle: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region
raw.description: The Wreck of Shattered Dreams

raw.title: Adeptus's Repose
raw.description: It is the former abode of the Herblord. It can be accessed by clearing the Miasma around the entrance or while completing the .

raw.title: Carp's Rest
raw.description: It is the abode of Fujin and is unlocked during the .

raw.title: Alta Semita
raw.description: It is an aqueduct that once carried Ichor from the Domus Aurea out into "the great lake in the far north." It visually resembles a giant harp.

raw.title: Caesareum Palace
raw.description: It used to be a training area for the legions of Remuria. In addition, it was used as a place to store Scylla’s chains.

raw.title: Broken Sea
raw.description: It is unlocked during the .

raw.title: "Scions of the Canopy"
raw.description: It is the home of the Huitztlan tribe.

raw.title: "Children of Echoes"
raw.description: It is the home of the Nanatzcayan tribe.

raw.title: "People of the Springs"
raw.description: It is the home of the Meztli tribe.

raw.title: Ancestral Temple
raw.description: It is a sacred site where the people of Natlan once communicated with the Night Kingdom. In modern times, this temple is no longer in use, as the tribes have established a more stable connection with the Night Kingdom. However, it is still considered "holy ground", and is actively guarded by the Scions of the Canopy. According to Legba, only "experienced Couriers" who have passed three trials may enter.

raw.title: Ameyalco Waters
raw.description: A water body formed where springs meet the coast, known for its slightly higher temperature compared to the surrounding coastal waters. This warmth is attributed to the magma chambers beneath.

raw.title: "Masters of the Night-Wind"
raw.description: It is the home of the Mictlan tribe.

raw.title: "Flower-Feather Clan"
raw.description: It is the home of the Tlalocan tribe.

raw.title: "Collective of Plenty"
raw.description: It is the home of the Teteocan tribe.

raw.title: Ancient Mountain Path
raw.description: It contains the Flowfire Experimentation Site, where ancient dragon researchers once developed a method of converting Phlogiston from liquid to solid form. The player gains access to this location during the Hidden Exploration Objective How Long Must We Wait, My Friend?

raw.title: Chamber of Deliberation
raw.description: It is an assembly hall where the rulers of the ancient dragon civilization once gathered to discuss administrative and judicial matters.

raw.title: Blue Amber Lake
raw.description: It sits on a raised plateau in between the north and south sections of Barrowmoss Barrens. Its unique climate gives it an ethereal glow at all times of day, and also makes it the only place where Stellafruit can grow. .

raw.title: Castle Joquiratto
raw.description: It is the stronghold of the main villain in Villa Guiztli's immersive adventure experience.

raw.title: Brewblossom Stores
raw.description: It is an underground facility for refining and storing Aphimead. It also hosts the "Honeydew Craftbrew" experience, in which visitors can participate in the brewing process.

raw.title: Barrowmoss Barrens
raw.description: It refers to the two plateaus located north and south of Blue Amber Lake.

raw.title: Amsvartnir
raw.description: It is a lake located north of Piramida, above which lies the Royal Court of the Seelie.

raw.title: Apathic Interval
raw.description: It is a transitional space where individuals chosen to be uplifted to the Temple of Space must relinquish all of their desires through the Maranasati meditation before entering the Temple proper, a process that can take centuries.

raw.title: Cage of Suchness
raw.description: It is the highest point of the Temple of Space where the Watchers dwell in order to oversee the temple. It is separated from the temple by the Corridor of Nothingness.

raw.title: Bubble Pool
raw.description: The Iridescent Lake

raw.title: Archaeolune Storm Research Center
raw.description: It is a ancient dragon research facility made to observe Archaeolune Storms.

raw.title: Dawn Winery
raw.description: The chief winery in Mondstadt and specializes in Dandelion Wine. Owned by the Ragnvindr Clan at least since Ragnvindr for the past 1,000 years, Event Invitation of Windblume Festive Challenge: Early Dawn the winery remains in operation to the present day. Its current owner, Diluc, inherited it four years ago after the untimely passing of his father, Crepus.

raw.title: Dihua Marsh
raw.description: Dihua Marsh is an alluvial plain shaped by the Bishui River. It is south of Stone Gate and north of Wangshu Inn. Sal Terrae lies to the east. There is a Statue of The Seven located on the northern end of Dihua Marsh, along the main road.

raw.title: Dadaupa Gorge
raw.description: It is the home to three important hilichurl tribes: the Meaty tribe, the Sleeper tribe, and the Eclipse tribe. An important location within it is the Sword Cemetery, which witnessed the battle against the monsters of Khaenri'ah.

raw.title: Dunyu Ruins
raw.description: It is one of the three locations where the Nameless Treasures can be found.

raw.title: Cider Lake
raw.description: Its never-freezing waters are used to create drinks such as apple cider.

raw.title: Falcon Coast
raw.description: The origin of the name Falcon Coast is from when the first Knight of Boreas fought demons from the Dark Sea on the coast, attracting thousands of falcons that circled the remains for several days.

raw.title: Cuijue Slope
raw.description: Located within the heart of the region are the Nine Pillars of Peace and a temple to the center. When the player enters the vicinity of the pillars, the sky will turn dark and gray, and areas outside Cuijue Slope will have an unnaturally dark appearance to them. This visual effect will persist until the player reaches a certain range away from the area.

raw.title: Entombed City - Ancient Palace
raw.description: An ancient city that lies silent beneath the eternal ice.
raw.frTitle: Palais antique de la Cité enfouie

raw.title: Entombed City - Outskirts
raw.description: A city that has been entombed by snow to the point it's nearly indistinguishable from its former past.

raw.title: Court of Fontaine
raw.description: It was once the court of Focalors, the God of Justice, established at least a thousand years ago. After the events of Masquerade of the Guilty, the court is now under the purview of Chief Justice Neuvillette. The city is also the base of The Steambird, a newspaper read all across Teyvat.

raw.title: Dornman Port
raw.description: It is a port town located north of Cider Lake.

raw.title: Chinju Forest
raw.description: It is a sacred grove nestled in a small river valley just south of Mt. Yougou. The path to the Kamisato Estate leads through these woods. Due to some unknown reason, this forest is shrouded in an eternal night, with the glow of an unseen moon casting a serene ambience within its borders.

raw.title: Devantaka Mountain
raw.description: Devantaka Mountain is home to a massive Ruin Golem, which the legendary scholar Pir Kavikavus once researched, resulting in a terrible accident. The Akasha System has no signal while on the mountain.

raw.title: Chinvat Ravine
raw.description: It is a ravine located below Sumeru City, at the base of the Divine Tree.

raw.title: Fane of Ashvattha
raw.description: It contains the Ashvattha Tree, the first Vasara Tree and the progenitor of the Aranara. It also acts as the seal for the entrance to Old Vanarana.

raw.title: Dar al-Shifa
raw.description: Dar al-Shifa, now abandoned, used to be a hospital that specialized in treating patients with Eleazar. Old hospital notes found at the site also suggest that one doctor was using the patients as test subjects for dangerous experimental treatments.

raw.title: Dunes of Steel
raw.description: This is the area of the Desert of Hadramaveth that connects it to Old Vanarana.

raw.title: Debris of Panjvahe
raw.description: The Forgotten River Valley

raw.title: Desert Pavilion
raw.description: It is the exhibition space in the Temple of Space that is devoted to sculptures and architecture. It was built in the style of the desert temples of Sumeru.

raw.title: Elynas
raw.description: The northern half of the main island of the Beryl Region, this location features the surface remains of the Beast of the same name.

raw.title: Elton Trench
raw.description: It is an underwater trench located between Elynas and Mont Automnequi. It is the final resting place of Fontaine's former Navy, which sank in the battle against Elynas.

raw.title: East Slopes of Mont Automnequi
raw.description: The eastern slopes of Mont Automnequi, a mountain in Fontaine spanning the Belleau Region and the Morte Region.

raw.title: Chizhang Wall
raw.description: It is located north of Mt. Xuanlian. The Solitary Suanni is located here.

raw.title: Chiwang Terrace
raw.description: It is unlocked by completing the .

raw.title: Chenlong Cleft
raw.description: It is a hidden cavern beneath the section of the river flowing under Jademouth, and is unlocked by entering the whirlpool during . After completing the quest, it cannot be entered or exited without a Teleport Waypoint.

raw.title: Faded Castle
raw.description: It is a sunken ruin that was once part of the kingdom of Remuria. The Harmosts and scholars of Remuria once lived there, maintaining the archives and researching music theory and fate. The castle contains the entrance to the Sea of Bygone Eras, an even deeper region that holds the main ruins of Remuria.

raw.title: Collegium Phonascorum
raw.description: It was once the educational center of Remuria, where the Harmosts and music lecturers taught Remurians about Phobos' Symphony.

raw.title: Clivus Capitolinus
raw.description: It refers to the hill that holds the heart of Capitolium: the Domus Aurea. The term also encompasses the cavern beneath the hill, which contains the Local Legend .

raw.title: Constellation Metropole
raw.description: It is unlocked after completing Step 7 of the .

raw.title: Firethief's Secret Isle
raw.description: It is a small island to the south of Coatepec Mountain. It is initially hidden from the Map, but is added after completing all four Time Trial Challenges located on the island. The perpetually overcast weather on the island will also be lifted upon completion of the challenges.

raw.title: Fallingstar Fields
raw.description: It contains the Tephric Ruins, a section of ruins that was ejected from the volcano around 500 years ago.

raw.title: Esoteric Arrays
raw.description: They were once used to perform arithmetic calculations.

raw.title: Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop
raw.description: It was originally started by Aino to research the "World's Best Krumkake Machine." Over time, it gained a new identity as a famous machine craftshop due to the prodigy's many other intricate creations. Event: Song of the Welkin Moon

raw.title: Colorfall Cliffs
raw.description: It features sprawling green fields painted with vibrant swirls of color. In the sky above hangs its main attraction, the "Airborne Asha".

raw.title: Easybreeze Market
raw.description: It is the commercial hub of the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, and many tourists' first stop on the island. It offers a variety of restaurants, specialty shops, and unique décor, courtesy of the local Asha.

raw.title: Colorfall Cave
raw.description: It is located just south of Colorfall Cliffs. At one point, it was used by associates of Rekis as a workshop for making counterfeit Koholasaur dolls. Zhaka was also held there after his kidnapping, until the Traveler freed him.

raw.title: Concealed Land of Enigmas
raw.description: It is a small cavern hidden behind a waterfall to the west of Wavey Bay. It contains a mystic portal that connects to the Pyro Archon Temple.

raw.title: Eye of Kratti
raw.description: It is a small island with a crystalline tree growing at its center. It hosts the shipwreck of the Atlas, along with many others.

raw.title: Final Night Cemetery
raw.description: It is the home of Flins and many ghosts of deceased Lightkeepers.

raw.title: Dreadshade Mire
raw.description: It is a fog-shrouded swamp where Solovei, the Torchforger, and Aila, the first Moonchanter of the Frostmoon Scions, used three ancient stone seals to imprison the Serpent of All Evils.

raw.title: Cliffwatch Camp
raw.description: It is an outpost of the Lightkeepers that keeps watch on the Abyssal activity at Kipumaki Cliff.

raw.title: Favonius Keep
raw.description: It is an outpost of the Knights of Favonius in Nod-Krai.

raw.title: Curtain-Form Blackbody Containment Lab
raw.description: The Concealing Veil

raw.title: Liyue Harbor
raw.description: Before the Archon War, Rex Lapis brought his people south of Mt. Tianheng, to found what is now known as Liyue Harbor. They tried to expand their city to Guili Plains, but after Guizhong died during the Archon War, they moved back to Liyue Harbor.

raw.title: Lingju Pass
raw.description: The area is mostly made of ruins with many puzzles to solve.

raw.title: Guyun Stone Forest
raw.description: It is an archipelago of seven large islands and smaller offshoots. The northernmost island houses the Geo Hypostasis, and the island to the southwest holds the Domain of Guyun. According to legend, this is where Rex Lapis defeated a god and sea monster known as Osial, and the jagged cliffs protruding from the islands at Guyun are in fact the remnants of the stone lances he used in that battle. It seems that those who spend the night at Guyun Stone Forest may experience Osial's memories of its defeat; whether this is caused by Osial's power or another phenomenon is unknown.

raw.title: Jueyun Karst
raw.description: It is said to be the place where the adepti live. Normally no one dares to try to set foot here, but some brave or desperate people still try to seek the adepti for good fortune. There are two Teleport Waypoints in this area: southwest of the domain Taishan Mansion, and another to the west leading towards Guili Plains.

raw.title: Huaguang Stone Forest
raw.description: It is surrounded by three mountains: Mt. Aocang to the north, Qingyun Peak to the east, and Mt. Hulao to the southwest. While there are no Teleport Waypoints in this area, the ones on the surrounding mountains can be used to easily reach it.

raw.title: Guili Plains
raw.description: It was the central area of the Guili Assembly, the ancient civilization ruled by Guizhong, the God of Dust, and Morax, the God of Geo. The location's name is derived from their names, Morax's name during this time is unknown, as "Morax" and "Rex Lapis" are names that were given to him after The Seven were established. However, it includes the li also found in his current vessel's name. and it is also called the Plains of Returning and Departing based on the characters taken from their names. During the Archon War, Guizhong died trying to defend her people, and the place was destroyed. After her death, Rex Lapis took his people and brought them south of Mt. Tianheng, where he established Liyue Harbor.

raw.title: Inazuma City
raw.description: Rising high atop the cliffs at the southern tip of Narukami Island, it was built during the Archon War and is the seat of power of the Shogunate and the Raiden Shogun. The city is renowned for its low crime rate and great many family businesses, and is considered to be the most lively and prosperous area in the nation. Most of Inazuma's population lives here, and as their numbers continue to grow the city tends to expand outward.

raw.title: Kamisato Estate
raw.description: One of the three great Commissions of Inazuma, the Yashiro Bugyo overseen by the Kamisato Clan is ostensibly charged with managing the ceremonial affairs and cultural lives of the people. In truth, its duties and responsibilities are so pervasive that even the Shogunate officials can't make heads or tails out of it. Notably, the Shirasagi Himegimi, the younger sister of the head of the household, is more popular amongst the people.

raw.title: Jinren Island
raw.description: A group of broken isles at the northernmost tip of Inazuma, swallowed by the shadow of mighty Mt. Yougou. In a less peaceful time, this land was crawling with deserters who fell into banditry.

raw.title: Konda Village
raw.description: A quaint village, it is known for its signature dish, Konda Cuisine.

raw.title: Kujou Encampment
raw.description: It is the headquarters of the Shogun's Army under the control of the Tenryou Commission. It is intended to guard against possible rebellion from the people of Watatsumi Island.

raw.title: Fort Fujitou
raw.description: A Watatsumi Army camp can be found at this location.

raw.title: Higi Village
raw.description: A Statue of The Seven is located on the northeastern side of the village. The Viewpoint for Serpent's Head, which is located southeast of Higi Village, can be found within the village.

raw.title: Fort Mumei
raw.description: Fort Mumei are the ruins of an ancient and majestic city that fell during the battle between the Shogunate and Orobashi’s forces in the Archon War, when he decided to invade Yashiori Island.

raw.title: Koseki Village
raw.description: The Silent Fishing Village

raw.title: Kunado's Locus
raw.description: It is initially hidden from the map and can be unlocked and shown on the map by starting the Erebos' Secret questline.

raw.title: Fuao Vale
raw.description: The Ancient Battlefield of Fuao Vale

raw.title: Gandharva Ville
raw.description: Also called "The City Above the Forest," it is the main outpost of Forest Rangers and is often frequented by travelers, merchants, and adventurers.

raw.title: Khemenu Temple
raw.description: It gets labeled on the map after completing the

raw.title: Khaj-Nisut
raw.description: Prior to The Secret of Al-Ahmar, it is named Eye of the Sands. The ruins that contain King Deshret's throne room are revealed upon completing the three trials in the World Quest Dreams Beneath the Searing Sand.

raw.title: Hills of Barsom
raw.description: The Hills of Barsom are located just north of Asipattravana Swamp. They are home to the Barsom, a huge pine tree with pink foliage, and its familiar, the Pari Rashnu.

raw.title: Fountain of Lucine
raw.description: It is a fountain situated in front of Opera Epiclese. It is said that all water ultimately gathers at the fountain.

raw.title: Fortress of Meropide
raw.description: It is an autonomous stronghold located underwater that serves as Fontaine's de facto prison. It is where criminals and other accused are sent after being convicted in a trial to serve out their sentences and has a notorious reputation in Fontaine. Wriothesley is the prison's Administrator, while Sigewinne works at the prison's infirmary.

raw.title: Institute of Natural Philosophy
raw.description: It is a dilapidated underwater research facility that once belonged to the organization of the same name, led by Director Dwight Lasker. Much of the Institute's research remains preserved within the ruined facility, including numerous precursors to modern-day Fontainian technologies and the earliest experiements of the Narzissenkreuz Ordo.

raw.title: Loch Urania
raw.description: It is a lake in Erinnyes Forest containing a large water vortex that forms a large bubble at the top.

raw.title: Foggy Forest Path
raw.description: It is located in the southern part of Erinnyes Forest by the water. It notably features a glowing blue tree.

raw.title: Fort Charybdis Ruins
raw.description: The ruins of a fort located on an island in the eastern part of the Morte Region.

raw.title: Jademouth
raw.description: It consists of massive pieces of jade flanking the Bishui River.

raw.title: Lingshu Courtyard
raw.description: Entering for the first time initiates the .

raw.title: Hortus Euergetis
raw.description: It is an underwater garden that derives its name from the deceased Harmost Euergetia.

raw.title: Initium Iani
raw.description: It is the entrance to the Passage of Ianus, the sole path between Machimos and Capitolium. Long ago, the Dragon Prince Scylla was sealed here by the joint efforts of Harmosts Boethius and Euergetia. Interactable, Caesareum Palace: Ancient Engravings #2

raw.title: Forest of Blessings
raw.description: It is unlocked when first entering Simulanka during the .

raw.title: Huitztli Hill
raw.description: It is a mountain to the north of the Stadium of the Sacred Flame. The area around the base of the southern cliff face is littered with the bones of a giant unknown creature.

raw.title: Grand Narukami Shrine (Subarea)
raw.description: Grand Narukami Shrine, Mt. Yougou

raw.title: Legendary Tonatiuh
raw.description: The Tonatiuh, also called the Skyserpent Ship, is a sky-faring ship built by the dragons, and later modified by Och-Kan. Originally envisioned as a satellite to anchor the "stairway" or "cable" leading from Chichen Uctokah into the space beyond Teyvat, it was turned on its side after Och-Kan seized the city. It is rumored to be filled with treasure, leading countless adventurers to search for it over the years. However, this was revealed to be a fake legend perpetuated by Kukulkan to lure in brave souls for his personal "experiment."

raw.title: Flame-Melding Ritual Grounds
raw.description: It is the site where Xiuhcoatl created the first Astral Assemblage — a feat comparable to forging a star.

raw.title: Heart of Force Inversion
raw.description: It is filled with pools of liquid Phlogiston that flow upwards into the sky.

raw.title: Guiztli Ridge
raw.description: It is a small island crowned with a single rocky ridge. Beneath it lies Villa Guiztli.

raw.title: Huha Hill
raw.description: It houses a cluster of villas and other lodgings. Amenities include rooftop pools, outdoor dining areas, and an excellent view of Colorfall Cliffs, Guiztli Ridge, and Wavey Bay.

raw.title: Guiztli Path
raw.description: It is a winding cavern that connects Villa Guiztli and Castle Joquiratto.

raw.title: Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau
raw.description: A colossal steel structure erected by the Fatui, its sheer bulk dominates the ancient landscape, an unsubtle declaration of power and control. Forged from cold iron and stone, it stands as a deliberate challenge to nature itself.

raw.title: Frostmoon Enclave
raw.description: It is the home of the Frostmoon Scions.

raw.title: Kipumaki Cliff
raw.description: It is a hotspot of Wild Hunt activity in northern Nod-Krai. The Scourge of Endless Decay was sealed there after Aila, Alia, and Solovei banished him for the first time 500 years ago.

raw.title: Golden Hall
raw.description: Come, come aboard the silver shining ship, and return to the great golden house.

raw.title: Mondstadt City
raw.description: Located in the west part of Starfell Valley on a large island in Cider Lake, Mondstadt features cobblestone streets and several windmills surrounded by a large stone on the east lower end. A statue of the Anemo Archon watches over the city, with the Favonius Cathedral in the back.

raw.title: Mt. Hulao
raw.description: The large pieces of Amber Rock found along the mountain are formed by flowers Mountain Shaper planted to keep out intruders. These plants, called karst crawlers, are mostly hidden underground and will produce Amber Rock to trap anything that steps on it. Breaking the amber will reveal what was trapped inside — either treasure or enemies.

raw.title: Mt. Aocang
raw.description: It was the domain of the adeptus Cloud Retainer while she lived in isolation, following the Archon War and until the events of A Thousand Moonlit Miles.

raw.title: Nantianmen
raw.description: This region notably features the Dragon-Queller, a large tree used to seal Azhdaha, whom Jiu worships. The dragon has begun merging with the tree, using its roots to connect to the ley lines and draw power from them. At the tip of the tree is a large blue branch, which points directly towards Liyue Harbor. That portion of the tree also cannot be climbed on.

raw.title: Luhua Pool
raw.description: It is a unique landscape consisting of brightly-colored pools, watched over by two statues.

raw.title: Musk Reef
raw.description: The main feature on the island is the portal to the Spiral Abyss. This island can be travelled to via a time tunnel, the bluish-purple portal, found at Cape Oath. Arriving at the island via the Time Tunnel grants the .

raw.title: Mingyun Village
raw.description: It is home to several scattered mining deposits, but many of them have since dried up, with the remaining few ores unable to keep up the village's survival. The inhabitants have since left westward towards Liyue Harbor and The Chasm for a better opportunity. Hilichurls have since moved in to the area to make use of the leftover facilities. Three small mining tunnels exist in the area around the village where one can find deposits of Iron Chunks, Noctilucous Jade, and Cor Lapis.

raw.title: Mt. Tianheng
raw.description: The pride of the mountain range that shelters Liyue Harbor from the west, acting as a natural shield against any enemies that may come that way. There are uncountable records of wars both big and small whereby enemies have been blocked by this barrier. As such you can still see ancient ruins of city walls, forts, and defensive structures. Liyue's earliest mining operations are also believed to have started in this area.

raw.title: Mt. Yougou
raw.description: The Grand Narukami Shrine sits at the top of the mountain along with the Sacred Sakura. Beside the mountain at the base is a large pool of Electrified Water that drains HP. After completing Sacred Sakura Cleansing Ritual, the pool becomes de-energized. The Version 2.0 livestream mentions that the mountain is related to the legend of tengu.

raw.title: Musoujin Gorge
raw.description: According to the legend, the strike that brought and end to the serpent god was slashed right here. In this deep canyon that runs through Yashiori Island, the remnant reverberations of lightning bolts continue to this day, as if the thunder elves are still chattering about the legendary scene that tore through the sky and the earth thousands of years ago.

raw.title: Nazuchi Beach
raw.description: A beach connecting Kannazuka and Yashiori Island, Nazuchi Beach has been ravaged by war for almost a thousand years. In recent years, it has been a place of interest for both the Tenryou Commission and Watatsumi Army, with weapons scattered all over the place. Both ground and naval engagements have taken place here, and third-party affiliates such as criminals have made the area a prime spot for looting what remains on the battlefield.

raw.title: Petrichor
raw.description: It is a town located on an island in the south of Fontaine. It is not situated on the continental plate that the rest of Fontaine sits on. The town is known for its beauty and its exceedingly pure waters, and is a popular tourist location to see the massive waterfall that encircles Fontaine. Interactable: Ancient Log #2

raw.title: Mt. Kanna
raw.description: Tsurumi Island

raw.title: Nameless Ruins
raw.description: There are massive mounds of solid dark mud at the floor of the ruins (which do not act like actual Dark Mud), and at the roof of the cave is an upside-down ruin that contains a water pool. There is a purple barrier around the Inverted City that is removed in .

raw.title: Mawtiyima Forest
raw.description: It is a forest made of enormous fluorescent mushrooms. Mawtiyima is described as "an energy form created by the ancient dreams and memories of the forest." This energy fights against The Withering to ensure the health of the forest, and even seems to be able to communicate with the Aranara. In an ancient tongue, the name once meant "human death."

raw.title: Pardis Dhyai
raw.description: It is a research site for Amurta scholars.

raw.title: Old Vanarana
raw.description: It was the home of the Aranara for hundreds of years before the cataclysm. It is unlocked by completing the Aranyaka: Part III - Nursery of Lost Dreams quest, For Fruits, Seeds, and Trees.

raw.title: Passage of Ghouls
raw.description: A passage depressed between two cliffs that connects Wadi Al-Majuj to The Sands of Al-Azif.

raw.title: Mt. Damavand
raw.description: Mt. Damavand, Where Sandstorms Never Cease

raw.title: Pavilion of Hermits
raw.description: It is unlocked after starting the . It is always nighttime while in the Pavilion of Hermits.

raw.title: Overgrown Valley
raw.description: It is unlocked after completing the .

raw.title: Opera Epiclese
raw.description: It is an opera house designed to function as the main courthouse of Fontaine, located on the island of Erinnyes. Besides trials, the building hosts a variety of other performances, such as Lyney's magic shows. Behind the opera house, the Fortress of Meropide can be accessed using a lift which descends to River Talionis. This lift is unlocked during .

raw.title: Lumidouce Harbor
raw.description: It is a coastal elevator and observation deck built on the side of a waterfall, similar to Romaritime Harbor. It serves as a vital trading port for Fontaine. The port handles a vast quantity of international trade, including tea and spices from Qiaoying Village and Sumeru, respectively.

raw.title: Merusea Village
raw.description: It is the home of the Melusines. It is located underwater within the body of Elynas and is described as "an adorable and mysterious village where even the chimneys bubble."

raw.title: Marcotte Station
raw.description: It is the terminus of the Navia Line.

raw.title: New Fontaine Research Institute
raw.parentTitle: Fontaine Research Institute of Kinetic Energy Engineering Region
raw.description: It is the current residence of the Fontaine Research Institute following the explosion at the Central Laboratory. Prior to that, it was known as the "Alain Guillotin Research Institute," and it hosted weekly lectures regarding critical projects.

raw.title: Mont Esus East
raw.description: It consists of the eastern foothills of the currently inaccessible Mont Esus.

raw.title: Mt. Lingmeng
raw.description: It is located west of Qiaoying Village and southeast of Yilong Wharf.

raw.title: Mt. Xuanlian
raw.description: It is located south of Chizhang Wall and south of Yaodie Valley.

raw.title: Mt. Mingyuan
raw.description: It is located west of Yilong Wharf, east of Fontaine, and under Celestia.

raw.title: Malinalco Grotto
raw.description: It is an underground cavern that contains a mural depicting the legend of Kuntur and Rumi. It can be accessed by taking the rightward tunnel at the entrance of the Tenebrous Papilla Boss cave.

raw.title: Nasha Town
raw.description: It is a seaside settlement that serves as Nod-Krai's main port and commercial center. It has no official governing body, and is instead under the influence of various factions, including the Voynich Guild, Curatorium of Secrets, Speranza, and Fatui. This makes it both a paradise of freedom and a lawless jungle.

raw.title: Nothing Passage
raw.description: It is a narrow mountain pass that cuts through the northern end of Lempo Isle. An entire Fatui company was wiped out there as a consequence of dubious experiments. After completing Colors of Emptiness, the entire passage becomes a Strong Kuuvahki Environment.

raw.title: Pillar of Embla
raw.description: It is a tower built by Rauthvangi that was meant to reach the false sky and help him to ascend to his "Elysium".

raw.title: Millhaven
raw.description: It is an idyllic village known for its beautiful Windrest Flower fields and production of fragrances.

raw.title: Old Sanatorium Site
raw.description: It is a former sanatorium that was torn down a few years ago. Marvelous Merchandise/2026-01-05, Dialogue Originally, it was built atop the ruins of the Temple of Space after it got lifted into the heavens. Map marker description, Temple of Space

raw.title: Luyang Academy
raw.description: It is the exhibition space in the Temple of Space that is devoted to art and painting. Its appearance is based on Liyue architecture.

raw.title: Mahavaipulya Chamber
raw.description: It is the exhibition space in the Temple of Space that is devoted to ancient texts. It also contains new novels written by some of the uplifted.

raw.title: Pillar Hall Central Zone
raw.description: It forms the temple's center and houses the Memory Core.

raw.title: Path of the Forgotten World
raw.description: It is the entrance area to the Temple of Space and Asmoday's adaptation of the Login Screen environment.

raw.title: Nuur Stone Circle
raw.description: It is an ancient dragon facility that records and stores their research data from the Frost Moon.

raw.title: Moontide Sea (Subarea)
raw.description: Sea of Broken Skies

raw.title: Qingce Village
raw.description: It is a tranquil village nestled at the foot of Mt. Qingce, with clear waters and terraced fields of flowers. Many of its younger residents have moved away in search of more exciting locales, so it has become known as a retirement spot for the elderly. Buildings in Qingce Village have a simple architectural style, and most are made of wood with blue roofs. The village is home to a community center where Granny Ruoxin can be found, the mill owned by Ms. Bai, a tea shop owned by Pops Kai, the Fanmu Carpenter shop owned by Master Lu, and a market. The Qingce Village Bulletin Board is where advertisements and other postings by locals can be read.

raw.title: Springvale
raw.description: Springvale features dirt-paved areas and one-story tan houses with blue-tiled roofs. One singular windmill watches over it, with a naturally-occurring spring right below it.

raw.title: Stone Gate
raw.description: It is the convergence of the roads to Dawn Winery (northeast), Wuwang Hill and Qingce Village (northwest), and Dihua Marsh and Liyue Harbor (south). There are two Teleport Waypoints in its vicinity, one towards the northern end of the area and one towards the west.

raw.title: Stormterror's Lair
raw.description: It was once the capital of Old Mondstadt, ruled by the God of Storms, Decarabian. After he was slain in an uprising, Barbatos took his place and reshaped the land. The people then moved the capital to an island in the middle of Cider Lake, where the City of Mondstadt remains to this day. Five hundred years ago, victorious but grievously injured by the corrupted dragon Durin, the Dragon of the East Dvalin fell into a deep slumber in the ruins of the former capital. However, the people of Mondstadt forgot about him and when he reawakened; they feared him and called him "Stormterror" — giving the region its current name. This, along with the pain from the poisonous blood clots inflicted by Durin, allowed him to be manipulated by the Abyss Order. The area is protected by a storm barrier, preventing players from entering until the is completed.

raw.title: Qingyun Peak
raw.description: It is the home of the adeptus Moon Carver. Notably, the Dwelling in the Clouds — a small floating island high above this mountain — can be reached by completing a puzzle. It was created by Cloud Retainer at an unknown point in the past.

raw.title: Stormbearer Mountains
raw.description: Located in the northern part of Starfell Valley, this was once a place to observe upcoming storms.

raw.title: Starfell Lake
raw.description: The Marsh of Celestial Guardians

raw.title: Qingxu Pool
raw.description: The ruins there are said to have been left behind by an evil god, and it was underwater until the end of the Archon War.

raw.title: Sal Terrae
raw.description: It was founded by Havria, the God of Salt, and was the last sanctuary she presided over for her people after conceding much of her land during the Archon War in hopes of peace.

raw.title: Stormbearer Point
raw.description: The coast just south of the area is where the Traveler begins their journey across Teyvat with Paimon.

raw.title: Starglow Cavern
raw.description: It is a large, icy cave at the heart of Dragonspine. It is likely named after the luminescent blue plants that blanket its interior, which are known as Starglow.

raw.title: Skyfrost Nail
raw.description: It is located at Dragonspine's summit. Access to this area is unlocked during the , and attempting to access this area beforehand by scaling the mountain will cause a unique Out of Bounds reaction before the player is teleported away. The area takes its name after the Celestial Nail that fell over the mountain from the heavens, freezing over the territory controlled by the ancient civilization of Sal Vindagnyr.

raw.title: Snow-Covered Path
raw.description: The path leading up the mountain is not as steep as expected, but it's coated in ice the whole way, so you still have to be careful! It's so cold here that even the grass won't burn. It feels like every few steps we are looking for the next heat source to warm back up, and if we didn't, then we certainly won't last long out here.

raw.title: Tatarasuna
raw.description: It is an island with a ring of mountainous crags. At its center sits a large blast furnace, the Mikage Furnace.

raw.title: Sangonomiya Shrine
raw.description: Sangonomiya Shrine is the base for the resistance army led by Sangonomiya Kokomi, that opposes the Raiden Shogun's Vision Hunt Decree. The current shrine is not the original shrine of the island — it was built after Orobashi died from the Raiden Shogun's attack.

raw.title: Ritou
raw.description: It is the area for central processing of all non-Inazuma nationals entering and leaving the nation. Before completing the Archon Quest Ritou Escape Plan, the Kanjou Commission Ashigaru will stop the Traveler from leaving Ritou on foot, barring access to the rest of Inazuma. After completing Ritou Escape Plan, the Traveler will be able to teleport out of Ritou to access other areas of Inazuma, but the Kanjou Commission guards will still prevent them from leaving on foot. After obtaining the Travel Permit from Kujou Kamaji in Chisato's Letter, the Traveler will finally be able to enter and leave Ritou without obstruction.

raw.title: Serpent's Head
raw.description: According to the legend, the giant serpent that once ventured into the deep sea was finally slain on Yashiori Island. It is also said that when the sea breeze passes through the eyes and sharp fangs of the giant snake, sounds of a whistle will ring in the wind. That is the requiem it composed for itself. Now, this requiem also provides for those who have fallen or were displaced in the war.

raw.title: Qiaoying Village
raw.description: It is a village in northwestern Liyue, bordering Fontaine, and is known for producing high-quality tea.

raw.title: Sumeru City
raw.description: Sumeru City is known across Teyvat as the "City of Wisdom." It is under the jurisdiction of the Sumeru Akademiya and is built on top of the Divine Tree. YouTube: [https://youtu.be/R2l9IpLVgXQ Sumeru Preview Teaser 02: Of Rain and Sand] The city features many districts and points of interest, such as the Grand Bazaar, Zubayr Theater, Treasures Street, and more. Located in the middle to top half of the tree is The Akademiya, which serves as the main base of the Sumeru Akademiya. On top of The Akademiya rests the Sanctuary of Surasthana, which is a treetop palace where Lesser Lord Kusanali resides.

raw.title: Port Ormos
raw.description: Port Ormos is the largest port in Sumeru and serves as a hub for trading and travel. It is located beneath two giant trees, between which a river runs from Sumeru City to the port. Though parts of Port Ormos are under the supervision of the Akademiya, smuggling and other illegal activity is more common at Port Ormos than in Sumeru City. Prices also tend to be lower than in Sumeru City. Most long-term residents in the port are traders and laborers who grew up in the area, but a number of Eremite merceneries from various factions can also be found there. Students often come to the port when academic life gets too stressful, and it is even considered good luck to some.

raw.title: Sobek Oasis
raw.description: Adventurers traveling through the Great Red Sand have been known to rest here.

raw.title: Tanit Camps
raw.description: It is home to the Tanit tribe. After completing the World Quest Her Foes Rage Like Great Waters..., the Tanit are removed from the area, with the Vahumana researcher Tanjiyy replacing them.

raw.title: Safhe Shatranj
raw.description: Prior to , the subarea is named The Temples Forsaken. During this quest, the name is changed and the sand is cleared.

raw.title: Samudra Coast
raw.description: Samudra Coast is located at the far northwest border of the Sumeru desert. It has sandy beaches and clear blue waters.

raw.title: Silver Bottle Courtyard
raw.description: It is unlocked after completing the .

raw.title: Romaritime Harbor
raw.description: It is a large coastal elevator and observation deck built on the side of a waterfall vista that extends to an aquabus rail to the Court of Fontaine. It also provides passage to Girdle of the Sands, Sumeru.

raw.title: Poisson
raw.description: It is a fishing village in the Belleau Region steeped in history and built from a great ship and a large cavern below sea level. The main base of the Spina di Rosula is also located here.

raw.title: Salacia Plain
raw.description: A calm and serene expanse of open sea with crystal-clear water. Many precious memories and secrets yet slumber beneath its scintillating surface.

raw.title: Portus Anticus
raw.description: It was once the royal port of Remuria; it has since sunk into an underwater cavern. In its prime, it had a lofty belltower, and the sound of its bells could "pierce the barrier of ocean" to guide sailors home.

raw.title: Stadium of the Sacred Flame
raw.description: It is considered the core landmark of Natlan, and houses a continually burning fire called the Sacred Flame.

raw.title: Sulfurous Veins
raw.description: Pins of Rock Entwined With Golden Runes

raw.title: Remnants of Tetenanco
raw.description: It is a cluster of ruins left behind by the ancient dragons. It is believed to have been a satellite city that was destroyed during the war between the dragons and the first Pyro Archon, Xbalanque.

raw.title: Skyfire Circlet
raw.description: It is a ring of islands suspended above the mouth of the Great Volcano of Tollan by the power of Phlogiston. Since it contains the only entrance to the Ancient Sacred Mountain, it is also known as Nahuatzin's Springboard.

raw.title: Summoning Hall
raw.description: It is connected to the mouth of the volcano at Skyfire Circlet, and serves as the entrance hall of the Sacred City of Tollan. It is where the Traveler first "reawakens" the ancient city and enters its depths.

raw.title: Sea of Shifting Sentience
raw.description: It contains large pools of Liquid Phlogiston, in which the ancient dragons once submerged themselves to absorb the knowledge and wisdom stored in the primal flame.

raw.title: Ruined Armament Workshop
raw.description: It was once a facility for manufacturing and storing weapons. The ancient dragons may have also used it for human experimentation.

raw.title: Starsand Shoal
raw.description: It is the location where the spaceship belonging to the Traveler and their sibling landed.

raw.title: Silvermoon Hall
raw.description: It is the current hiding place of Columbina following her departure from the Fatui. The player gains access to it during step 4 of the .

raw.title: Piramida
raw.description: It is a city on top of an ancient castle. It is the headquarters of the Lightkeepers.

raw.title: Wangshu Inn
raw.description: According to Zhongli, Wangshu Inn was built tall to provide visibility and is a strategic location that must be defended. It has existed since at least during the years right after the Cataclysm, nearly 500 years ago. As most of the patrons that stop here are traveling merchants, the inn provides an area for them to trade and set up stalls. The view from the top of the inn is jaw-dropping — weather permitting, you can see all the way to Mt. Qingce and Jueyun Karst in the distance. Legend amongst the stalls says that the tower of the inn hides a mysterious secret, but that's as far as the legend goes, as no one has ever been able to verify the claims. The inn itself is run by Verr Goldet and her husband, Huai'an, who are both secret agents under the Liyue Qixing reporting directly to Ningguang. The commercial aspect of the inn is a front to their real task of covertly assisting Xiao in his excursions of excising plagues from Liyue.

raw.title: Whispering Woods
raw.description: It is near Starfell Lake and the City of Mondstadt. It is also where the Traveler first meets Venti and Dvalin.

raw.title: Wolvendom
raw.description: It is home to Boreas, Wolf of the North of the Four Winds, and his wolf pack.

raw.title: Windrise
raw.description: It is the location where Vennessa is said to have ascended to Celestia, where she became a god and now watches over Mondstadt as the Falcon of the West of the Four Winds. The massive oak tree is believed to have grown there after she ascended.

raw.title: Thousand Winds Temple
raw.description: It is an ancient amphitheater that has been used as an arena back in the Aristocratic Period, where slaves were made to fight each other for the satisfaction of the old nobles.

raw.title: Tianqiu Valley
raw.description: There are two Teleport Waypoints in this area: one to the east and one to the south. On the western side of the valley are three ruined towers.

raw.title: The Serpent's Bowels
raw.description: This area does not have a battle theme.

raw.title: The Serpent's Heart
raw.description: The Serpent's Heart was created with the power of Sunfire Phantasms. It was used to "guard secrets, imprison criminals, and worship the great imaginary serpent, Ouroboros."

raw.title: The Chasm's Maw
raw.description: It serves as the entrance to The Chasm's underground mines.

raw.title: The Chasm: Main Mining Area
raw.description: The Underground Mines

raw.title: The Glowing Narrows
raw.description: The Great Mushroom's Place

raw.title: Underground Waterway
raw.description: Underground Waterway

raw.title: Twinning Isle/2.8
raw.image: Golden Apple Archipelago 2.8 Twinning Isle (First Change).png

raw.title: Vanarana (Subarea)
raw.description: There are two different versions of Vanarana: the one that exists in reality, and the dream version where the Aranara live (which is called Mahavanaranapna).

raw.title: The Palace of Alcazarzaray
raw.description: The Palace of Alcazarzaray is currently owned by Dori. It was designed by Kaveh and is considered to be his magnum opus.

raw.title: Vimara Village
raw.description: Vimara Village is a small, tranquil fishing town on the river between Sumeru City and Port Ormos, and many caravans pass through the village while traveling between the two.

raw.title: The Mausoleum of King Deshret
raw.description: There has been a great cyclone on top of the mausoleum for a long time, though the cause was never determined. It is permanently turned off after completing the .

raw.title: Valley of Dahri
raw.description: It is the location of a giant Ruin Golem. There are remnants of the Akademiya's investigation and medical reports on the Majuj (hilichurls) and remnants of the abyssal swarms. Moreover, there are notes on Zandik's research into the Khaenri'ah machines and elemental flows.

raw.title: The Dune of Elusion
raw.description: It is one of the ruins of King Deshret's civilization, and contains the Algorithm of Semi-Intransient Matrix of Overseer Network.

raw.title: The Dune of Magma
raw.description: A remnant of King Deshret's civilization. It is connected to the underground area The Mausoleum of King Deshret Southwest: Rock Cavern Area.

raw.title: The Dune of Carouses
raw.description: The Dune of Carouses is home to the Tomb of Carouses, which is described by Soheil as "a miniature version of the Mausoleum of King Deshret."

raw.title: Wadi Al-Majuj
raw.description: It is an area south of Mt. Damavand with a large canyon running through it.

raw.title: The Sands of Al-Azif
raw.description: One of the flatter areas of the desert, home to many roaming Wenut on the surface and the Wenut Tunnels below.

raw.title: The Sands of Three Canals
raw.description: An elevated area of the Desert of Hadramaveth north of Mt. Damavand.

raw.title: Tunigi Hollow
raw.description: During the cataclysm, Tunigi Hollow was the epicenter for numerous Abyssal monsters and mass forbidden knowledge pollution originating from Khaenri'ah. To avert the crisis, several gods, including Greater Lord Rukkhadevata and Egeria, ventured to Tunigi Hollow to suppress the defilement seeping from the godless nation below.

raw.title: Vourukasha Oasis
raw.description: Vourukasha Oasis is the birthplace and homeland of the Pari, who act as its guardians. It holds a "sea of pure dew" (Amrita) created from the remnants of the original Hydro Archon, Egeria. At the Oasis's center grows the Harvisptokhm, a giant tree that contains Egeria's remaining consciousness.

raw.title: Temir Mountains
raw.description: They serve as the primary passageway between the Desert of Hadramaveth and the rest of the Girdle of the Sands.

raw.title: Thinkers' Theater
raw.description: It is unlocked after starting the .

raw.title: West Slopes of Mont Automnequi
raw.description: The western slopes of Mont Automnequi, a mountain in Fontaine spanning the Belleau Region and Morte Region.

raw.title: Weeping Willow of the Lake
raw.description: It is a large willow tree that grows at the center of a lake in Erinnyes Forest. Its roots seem to extend underwater.

raw.title: Tower of Ipsissimus
raw.description: This tower, also referred to as the Sealed Ruined Tower or the Tower of Gestalt , was built by the Narzissenkreuz Ordo and served as their base of operations.

raw.title: Teatree Slope
raw.description: It is located south of Qiaoying Village and north of Yaodie Valley.

raw.title: Tepeacac Rise
raw.description: Slopes nestled in the northwest of Coatepec Mountain. The lower terrain is surprisingly conducive to plant growth, making it a frequent resting place for many Saurians. In Natlan, these slopes are also referred to as the “Genesis of the Mountains.”

raw.title: Teticpac Peak
raw.description: A plateau with a small lake at the highest point of Coatepec Mountain.

raw.title: Tecoloapan Bay
raw.description: It is an island to the west of Tezcatepetonco Range. It is initially covered in a thick fog, obscuring it from the Map, and the title "???" appears onscreen instead of its actual name when entering the subarea.

raw.title: Wavey Bay
raw.description: It is known for its sandy beaches, pristine waters, and numerous aquatic attractions.

raw.title: Tete Isle
raw.description: It is known for its lively atmosphere and its specialty drink, Aphimead. It is inaccessible until step 5 of the .

raw.title: Villa Guiztli
raw.description: It is an underground town located beneath Guiztli Ridge. It is inhabited by cardboard cutouts and Nochtlins, and hosts an immersive experience where visitors can play the role of heroes defending the town from the nefarious Progressing through is required to unlock this location fully.

raw.title: Wing of Keres
raw.description: It refers to the barrier islands on the western side of Wavechaser Plain. They are decorated with Verdant Crests and other Frostmoon Scion artifacts.

raw.title: The Eye of Ibni-Belum
raw.description: It was originally built as a deep-space signal transceiver station by dragon researchers to receive a signal from Nibelung. After many years without picking up a signal it was renovated into a lunar surface monitoring station.

raw.title: Traveler's Crater
raw.description: "The Next Journey"

raw.title: Ungien's Circle
raw.description: It is a biosphere constructed by the dragon researcher Ungien that serves as a home for living beings on the Frost Moon.

raw.title: Yaoguang Shoal
raw.description: It lies south of Mingyun Village and east of Guili Plains. To the far east side of Yaoguang Shoal is an unnamed "hidden" location dubbed Heart Island by players, for the heart-shaped puzzle located on the island. Unlocking the Luxurious Chest buried on the island requires standing on the heart with another player in Co-Op, and grants the .

raw.title: Wuwang Hill
raw.description: The area is known for its eerie atmosphere, as the skies will always be dark gray regardless of whether it is daytime or nighttime.

raw.title: Wyrmrest Valley
raw.description: It holds the remains of the great dragon Durin, namely his skull, ribcage, and heart. In some areas, the dragon's blood has dyed the ground a deep red color.

raw.title: Yachimatahiko's Locus
raw.description: It is initially hidden from the map and can be unlocked and shown on the map by starting the Erebos' Secret questline.

raw.title: Yachimatahime's Locus
raw.description: It is initially hidden from the map and can be unlocked and shown on the map by starting the Erebos' Secret questline.

raw.title: Yilong Wharf
raw.description: It is southeast of Lumidouce Harbor. Mail: Season of Scarlet Leaves... (2023-10-29)

raw.title: Wounded Shin Valley
raw.description: Where a Titan's Shins Were Broken

raw.title: Yaodie Valley
raw.description: It is located south of Teatree Slope. It is also located north of Mt. Xuanlian.

fr.frContent:
{{Voir homonymes|de la région de Mondstadt|la ville|Cité de Mondstadt}} {{Pays |image1 = Fichier:Emblème Mondstadt.png|Emblème Fichier:Mondstadt région.jpg|En jeu |monde = [[Teyvat]] |chapitre = [[Prologue]] |élément = {{Élément|Anémo}} |archon = [[Barbatos]] |corps_dirigeant = [[Ordre de Favonius]] |chinois = 蒙德 (''Méngdé'') |japonais = モンド (''Mondo'') |coréen = 몬드 (''Mondeu'') |nom = Mondstadt }} {{Quote| Une cité libre qui est située dans le nord-est du continent de Teyvat.
La brise de la liberté portant l'odeur des pissenlits se lève depuis les montagnes et traverse les vastes plaines, en passant au-dessus du Lac de Cidre pour apporter la bénédiction de Barbatos, l'Archon Anémo, à Mondstadt qui se trouve en son cœur.|Site officiel de Genshin Impact}} '''Mondstadt''' (de l'allemand ''Mondstadt'', « Cité de la lune ») est l'une des sept nations de [[Teyvat]]. C'est également dans cette région que débute l'aventure du [[Voyageur]] après être parti à la recherche de son [[Jumeau du Voyageur|Jumeau]]. C'est dans cette région qu'on adore [[Barbatos]], l'Archon Anémo. Avant la complétion de l'acte 1 du Prologue des quêtes d'Archons, [[Le voyageur qui attrapa le vent]], seules certaines zones de la [[Vallée Tombétoile]], de la [[Colline sifflante]] et des [[Hauts du Mornevent]] sont accessibles. Le [[Prologue]], Le voyageur qui attrapa le vent, se déroule dans cette région. {{Quote|Le [[Dvalin|dragon]] qui pendant mille ans a défendu la cité de la liberté a enfin fait face a son dilemme.
Qu'est ce que la liberté lorsequ'elle n'est que de l'ordre d'un dieu|Dainsleif dans ''Les Traces''}} ==Histoire== Voir [[Mondstadt/Histoire]]. ==Culture== Voir [[Mondstadt/Culture]]. ==Régions== ===[[Fichier:Emblème Mondstadt.png|35px|class=giw-emblem-light]][[Vallée Tombétoile]]=== {| class="article-table sortable" !Zone !Description !Image |- |[[Bois des Murmures]] |Une petite route traverse ce bois dense et profond. Le bruissement des feuilles soufflées par le vent pendant la nuit est souvent confondu avec des murmures par des voyageurs de passage.
C'est de là qu'il tire son nom. |[[Fichier:Bois des Murmures.png|sans_cadre]] |- |[[Cité de Mondstadt]] |Une cité libre qui est située dans le nord-est du continent de [[Teyvat]].
La brise de la liberté portant l'odeur des pissenlits se lève depuis les montagnes et traverse les vastes plaines, en passant au-dessus du [[Lac de cidre]] pour apporter la bénédiction de [[Barbatos]], l'Archon Anémo, à Mondstadt qui se trouve en son cœur. |[[Fichier:Panorama Cité Mondstadt.jpg|sans_cadre]] |- |[[Coin du guet]] |Les tempêtes étaient nombreuses et venait toujours de la mer bordant le Coin du guet. Mais grâce à la protection de Barbatos, ce temps est révolu au grand damne de certaine famille qui y ont perdu leur métier et ainsi leur vocation. |[[Fichier:Coin du guet.png|sans_cadre]] |- |[[Falaise Arrachétoile]] |Une imposante falaise située dans la partie est de la Vallée Tombétoile. |[[Fichier:Falaise Arrachétoile.png|sans_cadre]] |- |[[Lac de cidre]] | Un lac d'eau douce entourant la [[cité de Mondstadt]].
La grande superficie du lac et ses ondes scintillantes demeurent, même après des millénaires. L'eau est si claire qu'on peut apercevoir son fond. C'est d'ailleurs grâce à cette eau dont le goût est doux et frais en bouche que les vins de Mondstadt sont reconnus dans tout [[Teyvat]], faisant du Lac de Cidre un symbole de la cité. |[[Fichier:Lac de Cidre.jpg|sans_cadre]] |- |[[Lac Tombétoile]] |Il existait autrefois un poème racontant qu'une étoile tombée sur ces terres forma ce lac.
